title: Senior Campaign Manager
highlights: Promoted to Senior Campaign Manager within one year of joining as Media Analyst; manage lead-generation campaigns on Google, Microsoft, Yahoo and Meta for multiple clients, within a team book of business of roughly $4–5M in monthly ad spend.

Secured over $500K in approved client budget increases across four long-term accounts spanning healthcare, retail, and home improvement verticals through consistent CPL performance, renewal negotiations, and quarterly client reviews.
Delivered year-over-year performance gains on anchor account: grew qualified leads by 141% while cutting cost-per-lead by 56% through continuous keyword, smart bidding, and audience optimization.
Scaled paid social performance across Meta and Instagram, growing reach up to 113% and engagement (clicks/swipes) up to 105% year-over-year, while improving display ad CTR up to 50% YoY.

Home services client — CPL turnaround across 6 service lines: beat CPL goals in 5 of 6 verticals in a single month, including Windows (-69%, $851→$263), Bathrooms (-62% to $286), Siding (-55% to $347), Kitchens (-41% to $70), and Roofing (-35% to $162) — driving $48K/month in revenue impact.
Multi-market retail client: cut cost-per-lead significantly and grew monthly lead volume 2.2x–8x across three markets in one month.
Manage budget pacing and delivery across 100+ geographic and vertical market segments; run continuous A/B testing on ad copy and landing pages.
Deliver client-facing performance reviews and recommendations directly to executive stakeholders, translating campaign data into account growth strategy supporting 100% client retention.
